SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0483')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH primary_sub AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) AS payer_class,
           min(submission_date) AS first_submission
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
paid AS (
    SELECT s.payer_class,
           date_diff('day', s.first_submission, r.payment_date) AS days_to_pay
    FROM primary_sub s
    JOIN sem.remit_claims r
      ON r.claim_key = s.claim_key AND r.payer_key = s.payer_key
    WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claims,
       round(median(days_to_pay), 1) AS median_days_to_pay,
       round(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days_to_pay
FROM paid
GROUP BY payer_class
ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT r.claim_payer_key) AS denied_claims
FROM sem.adjustments a
JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id = a.remit_claim_id
WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied
  AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
GROUP BY a.carc_code
ORDER BY denied_claims DESC, a.carc_code
LIMIT 5

WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT min(payer_class) AS payer_class, claim_key, payer_key,
           count(*) AS n_events,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS current_not_denied
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS remitted_pairs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND current_not_denied = 1) AS first_pass_pairs,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND current_not_denied = 1) / count(*), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct
FROM pairs
GROUP BY payer_class
ORDER BY payer_class

WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT min(payer_class) AS payer_class, claim_key, payer_key,
           count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS n_traces,
           bool_or(is_reversal) AS has_reversal,
           bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current,
           coalesce(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication), 0) AS current_paid
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
    HAVING count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) >= 2
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS multi_trace_pairs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS pairs_with_reversal,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS pairs_without_current,
       round(sum(current_paid), 2) AS current_paid
FROM pairs
GROUP BY payer_class
ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT count(*) AS partial_denial_lines
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

WITH primary_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
)
SELECT coalesce(round(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 2), 0) AS deductible
FROM sem.adjustments a
JOIN primary_pairs p ON p.claim_key = a.claim_key AND p.payer_key = a.payer_key
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1'

WITH claims AS (
    SELECT claim_key, service_month, referring_npi
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01'
),
by_npi AS (
    SELECT service_month, referring_npi, count(*) AS n
    FROM claims
    WHERE referring_npi IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY service_month, referring_npi
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT service_month, n,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY n DESC, referring_npi ASC) AS rn
    FROM by_npi
),
totals AS (
    SELECT service_month, count(*) AS total_claims FROM claims GROUP BY service_month
)
SELECT t.service_month, t.total_claims,
       coalesce(sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.rn <= 5), 0) AS top5_claims,
       round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.rn <= 5), 0) / t.total_claims, 1) AS top5_share_pct
FROM totals t
LEFT JOIN ranked r USING (service_month)
GROUP BY t.service_month, t.total_claims
ORDER BY t.service_month

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '87798')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH cpt AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, procedure_code
    FROM sem.claim_lines
    WHERE is_latest_submission AND procedure_code IS NOT NULL
),
adj AS (
    SELECT claim_key, is_denied
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT c.procedure_code,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN a.is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS denial_rate,
       count(*) AS claim_payer_adjudications
FROM adj a
JOIN cpt c USING (claim_key)
GROUP BY c.procedure_code
HAVING count(*) >= 20
ORDER BY c.procedure_code

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT claim_key,
           CASE WHEN line_count <= 1 THEN '1' WHEN line_count = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END AS bucket,
           charge_amount
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE is_latest_submission
),
adj AS (
    SELECT r.claim_key, r.is_denied
    FROM sem.remit_claims r
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key
        FROM sem.claims
        WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    ) p ON p.claim_key = r.claim_key AND p.payer_key = r.payer_key
    WHERE r.is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT l.bucket, count(*) AS claims,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_denied) AS denied_claims,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_denied) / count(*), 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
       round(coalesce(sum(l.charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE a.is_denied), 0), 2) AS denied_billed_charge
FROM latest l
JOIN adj a USING (claim_key)
GROUP BY l.bucket
ORDER BY l.bucket

WITH fb AS (
    SELECT payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount AS amt
    FROM sem.provider_adjustments
    WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB'
),
carried AS (
    SELECT * FROM fb WHERE amt < 0
),
matched AS (
    SELECT c.reference_id, c.payment_date AS carried_date, c.amt,
           min(o.payment_date) AS offset_date
    FROM carried c
    LEFT JOIN fb o
      ON o.payer_key = c.payer_key
     AND o.reference_id = c.reference_id
     AND o.payment_date > c.payment_date
     AND abs(o.amt + c.amt) < 0.02
    GROUP BY c.payer_key, c.reference_id, c.payment_date, c.amt
)
SELECT reference_id, carried_date, round(-amt, 2) AS amount_carried_forward,
       offset_date, date_diff('day', carried_date, offset_date) AS days_between
FROM matched
ORDER BY carried_date, reference_id

WITH cur AS (
    SELECT payer_class,
           sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01') AS jul,
           sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01') AS aug
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
      AND payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01')
    GROUP BY payer_class
),
tot AS (
    SELECT sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01') AS jul_tot,
           sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01') AS aug_tot
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
      AND payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01')
)
SELECT c.payer_class,
       round(100.0 * coalesce(c.jul, 0) / nullif(t.jul_tot, 0), 1) AS july_share_pct,
       round(100.0 * coalesce(c.aug, 0) / nullif(t.aug_tot, 0), 1) AS august_share_pct,
       round(100.0 * coalesce(c.aug, 0) / nullif(t.aug_tot, 0)
             - 100.0 * coalesce(c.jul, 0) / nullif(t.jul_tot, 0), 1) AS change_pp
FROM cur c CROSS JOIN tot t
ORDER BY c.payer_class

WITH prim AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, frequency_code, submission_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
),
orig AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS orig_date
    FROM prim WHERE frequency_code = '1'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
repl AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS repl_date
    FROM prim WHERE frequency_code = '7'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cur AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payment_date, paid_amount
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT count(*) AS corrected_claims,
       round(avg(date_diff('day', o.orig_date, r.repl_date)), 2) AS avg_days_orig_to_replacement,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date) AS paid_on_or_after_replacement,
       round(avg(date_diff('day', o.orig_date, c.payment_date)) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date), 2) AS avg_days_orig_to_payment,
       round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date), 0), 2) AS paid_amount
FROM repl r
JOIN orig o USING (claim_key, payer_key)
LEFT JOIN cur c USING (claim_key, payer_key)

WITH void_claims AS (
    SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS void_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE frequency_code = '8'
    GROUP BY claim_key
),
paid_before AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v.claim_key
    FROM void_claims v
    JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = v.claim_key
    WHERE r.paid_amount > 0 AND r.payment_date < v.void_date
),
reversed_after AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v.claim_key
    FROM void_claims v
    JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = v.claim_key
    WHERE r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date >= v.void_date
),
cur_paid AS (
    SELECT coalesce(sum(r.paid_amount), 0) AS paid
    FROM void_claims v
    LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r
      ON r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM void_claims) AS voided_claims,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM paid_before) AS paid_before_void,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM reversed_after) AS reversed_on_or_after_void,
       (SELECT round(paid, 2) FROM cur_paid) AS current_paid

SELECT count(*) AS zero_paid_not_denied
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND coalesce(paid_amount, 0) = 0 AND NOT is_denied

WITH repl AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) AS payer_class, min(submission_date) AS repl_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE frequency_code = '7'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
first_after AS (
    SELECT r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key,
           min(e.payment_date) AS first_pay
    FROM repl r
    JOIN sem.remit_claims e
      ON e.claim_key = r.claim_key AND e.payer_key = r.payer_key
     AND e.payment_date >= r.repl_date
    GROUP BY r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.repl_date
),
days AS (
    SELECT payer_class, date_diff('day', repl_date, first_pay) AS days
    FROM (
        SELECT r.payer_class, r.repl_date, f.first_pay
        FROM repl r
        JOIN first_after f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
    )
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS corrected_claims,
       round(avg(days), 1) AS avg_days, min(days) AS min_days, max(days) AS max_days
FROM days
GROUP BY payer_class
ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT count(*) AS reversed_without_current
FROM (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
    HAVING bool_or(is_reversal) AND NOT bool_or(is_current_adjudication)
) t

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '80307')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH first_primary AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) AS payer_class,
           min(submission_date) AS first_sub
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT * FROM first_primary
    WHERE first_sub BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
),
first_remit AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payment_date) AS first_pay
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
)
SELECT c.payer_class, count(*) AS cohort_claims,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_diff('day', c.first_sub, f.first_pay) <= 14) AS remitted_within_14,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_diff('day', c.first_sub, f.first_pay) <= 14) / count(*), 1) AS within_14_pct
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN first_remit f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
GROUP BY c.payer_class
ORDER BY c.payer_class

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0482')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH repl AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS repl_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE frequency_code = '7'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.repl_date
    FROM repl r
    JOIN sem.remit_claims e
      ON e.claim_key = r.claim_key AND e.payer_key = r.payer_key
    WHERE e.is_denied_recorded AND e.payment_date < r.repl_date
    GROUP BY r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.repl_date
),
later AS (
    SELECT e.claim_key, e.payer_key,
           bool_or(x.payment_date >= e.repl_date) AS got_later
    FROM eligible e
    LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims x
      ON x.claim_key = e.claim_key AND x.payer_key = e.payer_key
    GROUP BY e.claim_key, e.payer_key
),
cur AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, is_denied, paid_amount
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
),
labeled AS (
    SELECT CASE
             WHEN coalesce(l.got_later, false) AND c.claim_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.is_denied THEN 'overturned'
             WHEN coalesce(l.got_later, false) THEN 'denied again'
             ELSE 'no remit since correction'
           END AS outcome,
           coalesce(c.paid_amount, 0) AS paid
    FROM eligible e
    JOIN later l USING (claim_key, payer_key)
    LEFT JOIN cur c USING (claim_key, payer_key)
)
SELECT outcome, count(*) AS claims, round(sum(paid), 2) AS current_paid
FROM labeled
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY outcome

WITH prior AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE adjudication_state = 'superseded' AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied
),
cur AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, paid_amount
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied
)
SELECT count(*) AS overturned_pairs, round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount), 0), 2) AS current_paid
FROM cur c
JOIN prior p USING (claim_key, payer_key)

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT claim_key, frequency_code, charge_amount
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE is_latest_submission
),
primary_sub AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS first_sub
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
open_claims AS (
    SELECT l.claim_key, l.charge_amount,
           date_diff('day', p.first_sub, DATE '2026-08-14') AS age
    FROM latest l
    JOIN primary_sub p USING (claim_key)
    LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r
      ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
    WHERE l.frequency_code IS DISTINCT FROM '8'
      AND r.claim_key IS NULL
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN age <= 14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age <= 29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END AS bucket,
           charge_amount
    FROM open_claims
)
SELECT bucket, count(*) AS claims, round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS billed_charge
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

SELECT count(*) AS never_remitted
FROM (
    SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS first_submission, bool_or(has_remit) AS remitted
    FROM sem.claims
    GROUP BY claim_key
) t
WHERE NOT remitted AND date_trunc('month', first_submission) = DATE '2026-07-01'

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount AS allowed
    FROM sem.remit_lines
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
      AND NOT line_is_denied
      AND units_paid = 1
      AND line_allowed_amount > 0
),
freq AS (
    SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, allowed, count(*) AS n
    FROM lines
    GROUP BY payer_name, procedure_code, allowed
),
typical AS (
    SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, allowed AS typical_allowed
    FROM (
        SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, allowed,
               row_number() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY payer_name, procedure_code
                   ORDER BY n DESC, allowed DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM freq
    ) s
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT l.payer_name,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.allowed < t.typical_allowed) AS underpaid_lines,
       round(coalesce(sum(t.typical_allowed - l.allowed) FILTER (WHERE l.allowed < t.typical_allowed), 0), 2) AS shortfall
FROM lines l
JOIN typical t USING (payer_name, procedure_code)
GROUP BY l.payer_name
ORDER BY shortfall DESC, l.payer_name

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0480')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH m AS (
    SELECT payer_class, payment_month,
           count(*) AS current_adjudications,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied,
           avg(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
    GROUP BY payer_class, payment_month
)
SELECT payer_class, strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       current_adjudications, denied,
       round(100.0 * rate, 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
       round(100.0 * (rate - lag(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY payment_month)), 2) AS mom_change_pp
FROM m
ORDER BY payer_class, payment_month

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '81479')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH primary_claim AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi
    FROM (
        SELECT claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi,
               row_number() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY claim_key, payer_key
                   ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM sem.claims
        WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND referring_npi IS NOT NULL
    ) s
    WHERE rn = 1
),
adj AS (
    SELECT p.referring_npi, r.is_denied
    FROM sem.remit_claims r
    JOIN primary_claim p ON p.claim_key = r.claim_key AND p.payer_key = r.payer_key
    WHERE r.is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT referring_npi,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS denial_rate,
       count(*) AS claims
FROM adj
GROUP BY referring_npi
HAVING count(*) >= 15
ORDER BY denial_rate DESC, referring_npi
LIMIT 5
